$ renpy.pause ()
Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗?

lines.en: Yes
lines.zh: 愿意。

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么?

lines.en: Who is sending me this?
lines.zh: 这是谁发给我的？

lines.en: : {i}Who is this? Where did you get my number?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是谁？你从哪儿弄到我的号码的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Your contact information was provided by a third party who advised you may be interested in our wares.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你的联系方式由第三方提供，对方告知我们你可能会对我们的货品感兴趣。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If this is not true, please feel free to disregard the message.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如情况不实，请不必理会此消息。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Since when is human trafficking so modern and accesible?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}人口贩卖从什么时候起变得这么现代、这么方便了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you are not interested, please feel free to disregard the message.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如你不感兴趣，请不必理会此消息。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm just saying this seems like a trap.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是说这看起来像个陷阱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you are interested, we are able to send additional photos from other angles verifying that the product is legitimate and in good shape.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如你有兴趣，我们可以发送其他角度的额外照片，以证明货品真实且状况良好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do I have to pay for these photos?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这些照片要付钱吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Payment is only accepted in regard to physical goods. All digital correspondence is complimentary.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们仅对实物商品收费。所有数字往来一律免费。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then I will glady accept any and all digital correspondence you may have.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那我就欣然接受你们所有、任何的数字往来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Your request is being processed. Please wait at least 24 hours for the images in question as our facilities are increasingly busy as of late.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你的请求正在处理中。由于我们的设施近来日益繁忙，相关图片请至少等待 24 小时。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Should you have any interest in purchasing this or any of our other products after the images are received, please let us know and arrangements will be made.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}收到图片后，如果你有意购买此货品或我们的其他产品，请告知我们，我们会做出安排。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Uhh...thank you?{/i}
: {i}The number you have texted is deactivated.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你发送短信的号码已停用。{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_day

What can she do?
lines.zh: 她会做什么？

lines.en: : {i}What...can she do exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她……具体会做什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The product shows great interest in both physical activity and cooking. With proper training, we believe she will provide an exceptional return on investment.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}该货品对体力活动和烹饪都表现出极大的兴趣。经过适当训练，我们相信她能带来极佳的投资回报。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Her language skills are limited to Japanese, but she is obedient and competent enough to take directions in other languages so long as the instructor is patient.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她的语言能力限于日语，但她很听话、也足够能干，只要指导者有耐心，用其他语言下指令她也能听懂。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Any...sexual skills?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}有什么……性方面的技能吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Our policy prevents us from engaging in sexual acts with our products as we believe it is best to view them exclusively as merchandise.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们的政策禁止我们与货品发生性行为，因为我们认为最好把它们完全视为商品。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We are able to advise, however, that to the extent of our knowledge, she has been entirely untouched throughout her life and does not appear to be fragile.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我们可以告知：就我们所知，她一生中完全未被碰过，而且看起来并不脆弱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As always, we recommend exercising caution when it comes to such action as accidents do happen.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一如往常，我们建议在这类行为上保持谨慎，因为意外确实会发生。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Should you have any interest in purchasing this or any of our other products, please let us know and arrangements will be made.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果你有意购买此货品或我们的其他产品，请告知我们，我们会做出安排。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll be in touch.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会联系你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The number you have texted is deactivated.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你发送短信的号码已停用。{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_day
jump feb2023packmenu
Where did you find her?
lines.zh: 你在哪儿找到她的？

lines.en: : {i}Was your, uhh...acquisition of this girl safe? Can you guarantee she's not being tracked or anything?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你，呃……弄到这个女孩的过程安全吗？你能保证她没有被人追踪之类的吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It is uncommon for a child to vanish without some form of report being filed in regard to their missing status.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一个孩子失踪却没有任何形式的报案，这种情况并不常见。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As such, we are unable to confirm the complete safety of the prospective purchase. But we are confident in our ability to maintain secrecy.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因此，我们无法确认这笔意向购买的绝对安全。但我们对自身保密的能力很有信心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, where did you find her exactly?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你们到底在哪儿找到她的？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A specific location, date, and time are unable to be disclosed. But we can confirm that the product was obtained at a recent sporting event.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}具体的地点、日期和时间无法披露。但我们可以确认，该货品是在近期的一场体育赛事上获得的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We have closely monitored all local media platform and have yet to see an instance of the disappearance being covered by any outlet.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们密切监控了所有本地媒体平台，尚未见到任何媒体对此次失踪进行报道。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you know her ethnic background? She doesn't look Japanese.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道她的族裔背景吗？她看起来不像日本人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A DNA test has shown that the product in question is half Japanese and half Egyptian. Her communication is limited exclusively to Japanese.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}DNA 检测显示，该货品为一半日本人、一半埃及人。她的交流仅限于日语。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And is the price negotiable at all?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}价格可以谈吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Your request for a price adjustment has been sent to the queue. Please wait at least 24 hours to her the new offer, should one exist.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你的调价请求已进入队列。请至少等待 24 小时以获取新的报价（若有）。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you do not hear back within this time, your request for an adjustment was likely declined.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果在此时间内没有收到回复，你的调价请求很可能是被驳回了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I see. I guess I'll wait to hear back, then.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}明白了。那我等着回复吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is there any risk in the girl being sold within this timeframe?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在这段时间里，这女孩有被卖出去的风险吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The number you have texted is deactivated.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你发送短信的号码已停用。{/i}
